content: To start, we assign an initial embedding vector to every medical code $c_\ast \in \mathcal {O}_\ast $ with a learnable embedding matrix $\mathbf {W}_e \in \mathbb {R}^{|\mathcal {O}_\ast | \times d}$ where $d$ is the embedding dimension.
